default._resident_note: 422,208 → 422,504 B (+296) for the `Next: <category>` stat fields' per-category cache (#951, epic #946, U5). Figures are **CI's** (the `embedded` job is the gate and runs floating stable); the pinned local host links 8 B less resident (422,496 measured here) and a different flash figure, neither of which is gated — Both resident figures were **confirmed against the `embedded` job** (run 30371199831: 422,504 B linked resident, `app` 136,504 B, identical on the `default` and `ble` legs), and `measured_flash` below is taken from the same log. The whole increase is one named allocation: `app` 136,208 → 136,504 (+296), i.e. `size_of::<App>()`. It is the new `UiRuntime::next_ahead` (`NextAhead`): six cache lines of `Option<NextPoi { u32, String<24> }>` + an `Option<u32>` take anchor, plus the scheduler's request/turn/route fields. Held once in `App` for the same #425 reason as `poi_scratch` and `corridor_scratch` — a `Screen` variant is a slot in a `.bss` union, so inline it would multiply across all 10 stack slots. It buys the stat tiles their answer *without* a second 16-slot corridor buffer: the snapshot is distilled to one `(dist_along_m, name)` per category and the shared `CorridorScratch` is reused as-is. Poll frame unmoved at 9,728 B. Previously: 422,080 → 422,208 B (+128) and flash 1,190,108 → 1,189,884 for the OBCR v3 waypoint record (#947). Figures are **CI's** (the `embedded` job is the gate and runs floating stable); the pinned local host links 8 B less resident and a different flash figure, neither of which is gated. The whole increase is one named allocation: `app` 136,080 → 136,208 — the resident `Waypoints` table's 32 × `WptEntry` at +4 B each, the entry having gained `category: Option<PoiCategory>` (1 B, niche-packed) and `lateral_offset_m: i16`, which fit in the record's existing tail padding. Nothing else moved, and flash *fell* 224 B (the reader lost its two-version branches). Poll frame unmoved at 9,728 B. Previously: 421,224 → 422,080 B (+856) and flash 1,185,668 → 1,190,108 for the route-corridor POI snapshot (#948, epic #946). Figures are **CI's** (the `embedded` job is the gate and runs floating stable); the pinned local host links 8 B less resident, the usual layout difference, and a different flash figure — neither is gated. The whole increase is **one named allocation**: `app` 135,224 → 136,080 B (+856), i.e. `size_of::<App>()`. Nothing else moved — the delta and the `app` delta are the same 856 bytes. It is the new `UiRuntime::corridor_scratch` (`CorridorScratch`): a 16-slot `heapless::Vec<CorridorPoi>` (16 × 52 B = 832) plus its `want`/`taken_for` snapshot keys. Held once in `App` **by design**, exactly like `poi_scratch` before it — inline in the `Screen` union it would multiply across all 10 stack slots (~8.6 KB) instead of costing the buffer once (issue #425). Poll frame unmoved at 9,728 B.

floating_stable_observation._comment: Hand-recorded snapshot of what CI's floating-stable toolchain links; nothing regenerates it. SUPERSEDED as of #927: the profile figures above are now taken from CI directly (run 30306462532), so this block no longer carries the only CI datapoint. Kept for the trend it records — CI at 5eb3e72e linked 421,128, at 9bb7adf8 421,176, and with #927 421,224 — and for the point it was written to make: floating stable links the same resident set and the same poll frame as the pinned toolchain, differing only in flash.
